scope: Isolated Club Board / contracts / payroll / progression / Match Squad
scenarios: new club creates unpaid ownership/player documents and two pending Board offers
JWT routes enforce recipient identity, counter versions and idempotent acceptance
separate management/player pay is committed once within the shared budget
player role does not bypass salary band; signing bonus debits and credits exactly once
player counter, Manager withdrawal and player decline retain active accepted pay
weekly payroll waits seven days and retries without duplicate payment
insufficient funds record arrears; recovery pays without destroying debt evidence
Card API starts at Level 1 without importing EA OVR or historical XP
real Match Squad routes enforce club permission and published goalkeeper/ANY rules without availability records
captured official participation earns XP once; unused players earn none and invalidation revokes XP
a failed player ledger insert rolls back the paired club debit and player credit
renewal is a separate scheduled agreement and does not overwrite current accepted pay
real tournament create, published rules, insufficient/sufficient squad entry, renewed consent and entry fees connect without double charges
congratulation delivery is durable and deleting the mail does not cause a retry to recreate it
ending the Manager’s player agreement requires authorization and preserves club ownership
